title: 8BitDo All-Button Arcade Controller for Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One & PC

comparisons.notes: Official 8BitDo store lists SKU/barcode 81JB01D, the same Xbox all-button arcade controller in black, at $99.99 and in stock.

amazon_match_notes: ASIN taken from the Woot offer page data and verified as the exact match by the price checker.
writeup: Woot's sellout event has the 8BitDo All-Button Arcade Controller for Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One and PC new for $54.99, limit one per customer. It's a leverless fight pad with 16 hot-swappable Kailh low-profile switches and 2.4G wireless. 8BitDo's own store charges $99.99 for the same model, so this is about 45% less.
